source_en: Uduki

source_en: However, your FLS is a total Void.⏎There is no ambiguity in it whatsoever.

source_en: Voids seek to become human. The stronger the Void, the closer it comes⏎to attaining human form. Their ultimate form is humanity. I cannot⏎reject the possibility that you are an abnormal and exceptional Void.
